author: Thomas Hardy
title: Wessex Poems and Other Verses
edition: Poems from Wessex Poems and Other Verses in the combined Macmillan 1919 edition with Poems of the Past and the Present; the transcription explicitly identifies this printing. Prose line wraps are reflowed to spaces; paragraph boundaries and poetry line/stanza breaks are retained. Outer block whitespace, illustration markers, and publisher/digitizer matter are omitted; original transcription punctuation and emphasis conventions are retained. Text follows the Project Gutenberg plain-text file, including its underscore emphasis and double-hyphen dash conventions.

rights.basis: This original English text/edition was published in 1919, before 1931, and its US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies this transcription as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 3167 plain text (UTF-8) from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org. Removed the PG header and footer, the transcriber's credit, title-page imprint, copyright leaf, contents, the transcriber's descriptions of Hardy's sketches ([Picture: ...]) and the star rows that frame them (star rows inside poems kept); kept the author's preface and every poem in printed order. Poem titles with their subtitle lines are level-2 headings (lines joined by line breaks); stanzas keep their lines with the block's outer whitespace trimmed and inner indentation kept; prose and date lines joined with single spaces, keeping the transcription's double spaces.

scope.note: Holds the whole of Wessex Poems and Other Verses (preface, poems and Additions) as PG 3167 transcribes it from the combined 1919 volume; the volume's second collection, Poems of the Past and the Present, is a separate work and is not held.
